rule.title: Newark Rent Control Ordinance: retaliatory eviction bar
rule.requirement: A landlord may not bring an action to recover possession of a dwelling unit as a reprisal for the tenant's efforts to secure or enforce any right under the rent control chapter. The statement of policy also ties rent control to the fear of eviction without just cause, but the chapter lists no allowed causes, notice contents or relocation assistance.
rule.key_value: No eviction action as reprisal for tenant's efforts to secure or enforce rights under the rent control chapter

coverage.summary: Applies to dwelling units subject to the Newark rent control chapter (all multiple dwellings, less exempt dwellings).

rule.effective_date_note: Section last amended 9-18-2024 by Ord. No. 6PSF-I; original effective date not stated for this section.
rule.quoted_span: No landlord shall bring any action to recover possession of a dwelling unit as a reprisal for the tenant's efforts to secure or enforce any right under this chapter.
rule.review_note: Reprisal protection only; no general just-cause list in this chapter.

rule.title: Newark protected tenancy for seniors and disabled tenants facing condo/co-op conversion eviction
rule.requirement: The Rent Control Office Administrator accepts applications from senior citizen or disabled tenants to determine eligibility for protected tenancy status against eviction resulting from condominium or cooperative conversion. Eligibility follows the state Senior Citizens and Disabled Protected Tenancy Act (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.22). The landlord pays a $350 hearing officer fee and a $30 notification fee per tenant.
rule.key_value: Protected tenancy status from eviction due to condo/co-op conversion for eligible seniors and disabled tenants

unverifiable_exemptions: Tenant eligibility as a senior or disabled tenant under N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.22
coverage.summary: Senior citizen and disabled tenants in buildings undergoing condominium or cooperative conversion.
coverage.other_conditions: Eligibility determined by state protected tenancy standards.

rule.effective_date_note: Section last amended 9-18-2024 by Ord. No. 6PSF-I; original effective date not stated.
rule.quoted_span: The Administrator of the Office of Rent Control shall be empowered to accept applications from senior citizen tenants or disabled tenants for the purpose of determining their eligibility for protected tenancy status from eviction resulting from condominium or cooperative conversions.
rule.review_note: Administrative process implementing state law; the substantive protection comes from N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.22 et seq.
